data.name: abeliel
data.long_meaning: Name of the second son of Adam and Eve according to the Book of Genesis, derived from the Hebrew words ‘ābhel’ meaning ‘breath’ and ‘el’ meaning ‘God'. Abel was a shepherd, and Cain, his elder brother, was a farmer. Their rivalry ended in Cain murdering Abel, marking the beginning of sin and conflict in the world.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the breath of God and the beginning of life.

in_hebrew.name: אַבְּלִיאֵל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אַבְּלִיאֵל הוא שם עברי שמשמעו אלוהים אבי, ומורכב משני חלקים: אב שפירושו אב, ואל שפירושו אלוהים, השם הזה משמש כשם פרטי ונפוץ בקרב יהודים ונוצרים, ומבטא את האמונה באלוהים כאב הכל יכול

in_greek.name: Αβελιήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αβελιήλ είναι eine ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος אַבְּלִיאֵל, και σημαίνει ο Θεός είναι πατήρ, και αποτελείται από δύο μέρη: τον πατέρα και τον Θεόν, το όνομα αυτό χρησιμοποιείται ως προσωπικό όνομα και είναι διαδεδομένο μεταξύ Εβραίων και Χριστιανών, και εκφράζει την πίστη στον Θεό ως τον Παντοδύναμο Πατέρα

in_latin.name: Abeliel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Abeliel est forma latina nominis hebraici אַבְּלִיאֵל, et significat Deus est pater, et constat ex duobus partibus: pater et Deus, nomen hoc utitur ut nomen personale et est diffusum inter Iudaeos et Christianos, et exprimit fidem in Deum ut Patrem Omnipotentem

in_english.name: Abeliel
in_english.long_meaning: The name Abeliel is derived from the Hebrew name אַבְּלִיאֵל, and means God is my father, and consists of two parts: ab meaning father, and el meaning God, this name is used as a personal name and is popular among Jews and Christians, and expresses the belief in God as the All-Powerful Father

data.spiritual_significance: The name "Abeliel" carries profound spiritual significance, summoning the memory of the righteous Abel, whose unwavering faith, piety, and dedication to his livestock earned him favor in the sight of God. Tragically, his untimely death at the hands of his own brother, Cain, serves as a solemn reminder of the potential for both good and evil within human nature. Despite the grave comprising his life, Abel's story has stood the test of time, inspiring generations with its powerful themes of devotion, sacrifice, and redemption.

seo.description_paragraph: Abeliel is a name rooted in the rich history of the Hebrew tradition and the Bible. The name Abeliel is derived from the Hebrew words ‘ābhel’ meaning ‘breath’ and ‘el’ meaning ‘God'. This name holds significant religious value for Christians, as it represents the second son of Adam and Eve, whose story is told in the Book of Genesis. In this narrative, Abel was a shepherd, and Cain, his elder brother, was a farmer. Their rivalry ended tragically when Cain murdered Abel, marking the beginning of sin and conflict in the world. Despite this dark past, the name Abeliel continues to be cherished as a symbol of faith and the bond between brothers.
